versions.content: Usage of VendorSpecificServiceNeeds It is possible to define VendorSpecificServiceNeeds for the purpose of implementing a vendor- specific, i.e. non-standardized, service. VendorSpecificServiceNeeds does not provide any attributes and its meaning shall be described by means of the category attribute.
